decisions.statement: A row whose `at` names no repository and no path inside is refused.
A row missing a slug is skipped without a refusal.
A page type extending itself or a slug no answer held is left unreached rather than made a root.
An unreached name is a page type no drawing reached.
A page type names any number of types above that page type.
A page type is drawn once under every type above that page type.
The drawing under the first type a page type names above that page type keeps the id `type/<slug>`.
A later drawing takes its id from the parent that drawing hangs under.
Everything under a later drawing takes its id from that drawing.
A type already open above the type being drawn is left out.
A ring among the types above ends the descent.
A second drawing of a type is no reason to leave that type out.
An assembly with two nodes with one id is refused rather than returned to the editor.
A repeated id reaches nothing but the refusal.
No page property and no page property type is drawn.

definition: the tree of page types a page query answer is turned into
